title: New: the monster pike, the new moves and the rescue
note: Two choices of each, none in the game yet. Reply with a letter for each of the seven: hooked, line snaps, surfacing, jaws, kick, Claw Slash, rescue.

sounds.label: Pike hooked A
sounds.what: A dull wooden thump, then a low plucked string: the line goes taut.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "75 CC0 breaking / falling / hit sfx" by rubberduck, with a pluck from "Interface Sounds" by Kenney, both from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Pike hooked B
sounds.what: A deeper stomp with a shorter, tighter pluck.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "80 CC0 creture SFX #2" by rubberduck, with a pluck from "Interface Sounds" by Kenney, both from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Line snaps A
sounds.what: A dry crack, like a stick breaking.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "75 CC0 breaking / falling / hit sfx" by rubberduck, from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Line snaps B
sounds.what: A whip of air and a twang.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "Swishes Sound Pack" by artisticdude, with a pluck from "Interface Sounds" by Kenney, both from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Pike surfacing A
sounds.what: A heavy, low splash: something big comes up.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "40 CC0 water / splash / slime SFX" by rubberduck, from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Pike surfacing B
sounds.what: A longer, brighter splash with more spray.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "40 CC0 water / splash / slime SFX" by rubberduck, from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Pike's jaws snap A
sounds.what: The crocodile's bite played lower and longer, with a wet slap.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "Crunchy bite" by fvcalderan, with a splash from "40 CC0 water / splash / slime SFX" by rubberduck, both from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Pike's jaws snap B
sounds.what: A hard, bright clack with a dull wet slap under it.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "Thwack Sounds" by AntumDeluge, with a splash from "40 CC0 water / splash / slime SFX" by rubberduck, both from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Walblum's kick A
sounds.credit: Recorded: "Punch" by qubodup, from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Walblum's kick B
sounds.credit: Recorded: "Thwack Sounds" by AntumDeluge, from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Claw Slash A
sounds.what: Three quick swishes, each a little higher.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "Swishes Sound Pack" by artisticdude, from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Claw Slash B
sounds.what: Three scratches over one swish: more edge, less air.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "Interface Sounds" by Kenney, with a swish from "Swishes Sound Pack" by artisticdude, both from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: The rescue A
sounds.what: A rising chime, about a second and a half.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "Chimey UI Sounds" by MouseBYTE, from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: The rescue B
sounds.credit: Recorded: "Chimey UI Sounds" by MouseBYTE, from OpenGameArt. CC0.
